reserves.name: Brazilian-real cash deposited in a Brazilian bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wBRL - June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 certification reconciles 2,586,148 outstanding wBRL across seven chains to R$2,594,240.11 in a Brazilian bank account and certifies full local-currency backing. Pablo Eduardo Soto signed the certification on July 28, 2026 for SLD y Asociados S.A. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion. The bank and account terms remain undisclosed. The official wFIAT attestation index serves this report as its latest wBRL evidence on September 30, 2026; the 92-day-old balance date remains outside the live adapter's 33-day freshness ceiling.
